paragraphs.text: Urdom was a warrior and alleged hydra -slayer of Tazeem who hired himself out as a guide across the Teeth of Akoum .

Urdom supposedly killed stalking hydra of the Vastwood with his bare hands and climbed the Kazandu sky cliffs without a rope, although the truth of these deeds seems to be in doubt. He was hired by Sachir to guide Chandra Nalaar across the Teeth of Akoum to Anowon 's camp for a single gold coin.
As Sachir told it, Urdom knew the only right way through the spike fields , but during their trek, he and Chandra were attacked by fire-breathing rock lizards , and Urdom was killed.
